capabilities: Create a new note by cloning chosen properties from an existing note
Trigger cloning via ribbon icon, command palette, or file-explorer right-click
Select which property keys to carry over in a modal checklist
Add a source link property pointing back to the original note
Configure default-excluded keys and the source link property name
disambiguation: Not a citation or reference manager; 'reference' here means using an existing note as the source to copy properties from.
extras: The README's 'Result' section is empty and there are no screenshots; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian makes you re-type the same set of properties every time you create a note that should share them with an existing one.
summary: Note-creation tool that clones selected properties from an existing note into a new note, with an optional back-link to the source.
